faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Downhole Wireline Barrel suitable for Downhole wireline logging tool pressure barrel?
faq.a: Titanium Downhole Wireline Barrel uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address oil & gas operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Downhole Wireline Barrel?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Downhole Wireline Barrel is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for downhole wireline logging requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Downhole Wireline Barrel require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. downhole wireline logging components require Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for downhole wireline logging application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Downhole Wireline Barrel shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Downhole Wireline Barrel includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet downhole wireline logging specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
